lines.text: Paul's chains became known throughout the whole Sanhedrin, and most of the brothers now speak the word without fear.
Some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry and others out of goodwill, yet Paul rejoices that Christ is preached.
Paul knows his distress will turn out for his deliverance through your gifts and the provision of the Spirit.
Paul says to live is Christ and to die is gain, yet he knows he will remain for their progress.
Paul tells them to stand firm in one spirit, unafraid of opponents, since suffering for Christ is granted.
